.. py:function:: matplotlib_to_plotly_colorscale(colormap, n_colors=256)

   Converts a matplotlib colormap to a Plotly colorscale

   :param colormap: Colormap to convert
   :type colormap: matplotlib colormap
   :param n_colors: Number of colors in the colormap (default is 256).
   :type n_colors: int, optional

   :returns: Plotly colorscale
   :rtype: List


.. py:function:: reduce_points_number(df_input, n_cycle)

   Reduces the number of points in the dataframe

   :param df_input: DataFrame containing the data to plot
   :type df_input: pandas.DataFrame
   :param n_cycle: Number of points that we want to keep for a single cycle
   :type n_cycle: int

   :returns: DataFrame with reduced number of points
   :rtype: pandas.DataFrame


.. py:function:: get_colorscale(state, nb_cycle, i)

   Returns the Plotly colorscale for a given state

   :param state: State of the cell charging
   :type state: ['C', 'D']
   :param nb_cycle: Total number of cycles
   :type nb_cycle: int
   :param i: Cycle number
   :type i: int

   :returns: Plotly colorscale corresponding to the charging state
   :rtype: Plotly colorscale


.. py:data:: title_size
   :value: 45


.. py:data:: axis_size
   :value: 35


.. py:data:: legend_size
   :value: 35


.. py:data:: tickfont_size
   :value: 35


.. py:data:: marker_size
   :value: 10


.. py:data:: line_width
   :value: 3


.. py:function:: plot_test_over_time(df_input, file_path, test='CCCV', pulse=False, save=False, png=False)

   Plots the Current, Voltage and Capacity over TestTime for a given test type

   :param df_input: DataFrame containing the data to plot
   :type df_input: pandas.DataFrame
   :param file_path: Path to the file to process
   :type file_path: str
   :param test: Type of test to plot (default is 'CCCV')
   :type test: str, optional
   :param pulse: Whether the test type contains current pulses (default is False)
   :type pulse: bool, optional
   :param save: Whether to save the plots as .html files(default is False).
   :type save: bool, optional
   :param png: Whether to display the plots as .png files (default is False).
   :type png: bool, optional

   :returns: Plot as a Plotly figure
   :rtype: go.Figure


.. py:function:: plot_DQDV_result(df, file_path, save=False, png=False)

   Plots the dQ/dV curve

   It gives the derivative of Capacity over Voltage

   :param df_input: DataFrame containing the data to plot
   :type df_input: pandas.DataFrame
   :param file_path: Path to the file to process
   :type file_path: str
   :param save: Whether to save the plots as .html files(default is False).
   :type save: bool, optional
   :param png: Whether to display the plots as .png files (default is False).
   :type png: bool, optional

   :returns: Plot as a Plotly figure
   :rtype: go.Figure


.. py:function:: plot_dqdv_heatmap(df, file_path, save=False, png=False)

   Plots the dQ/dV heatmap

   It gives a plot with Cycles over Voltage colored by the magnitude of dQ/dV

   :param df_input: DataFrame containing the data to plot
   :type df_input: pandas.DataFrame
   :param file_path: Path to the file to process
   :type file_path: str
   :param save: Whether to save the plots as .html files(default is False).
   :type save: bool, optional
   :param png: Whether to display the plots as .png files (default is False).
   :type png: bool, optional

   :returns: Plot as a Plotly figure
   :rtype: go.Figure


.. py:function:: plot_pocv(df, file_path, save=False, png=False)

   Plots the POCV curve

   It gives a plot of the Capacity over Voltage

   :param df_input: DataFrame containing the data to plot
   :type df_input: pandas.DataFrame
   :param file_path: Path to the file to process
   :type file_path: str
   :param save: Whether to save the plots as .html files(default is False).
   :type save: bool, optional
   :param png: Whether to display the plots as .png files (default is False).
   :type png: bool, optional

   :returns: Plot as a Plotly figure
   :rtype: go.Figure


.. py:function:: plot_GITT_result(df, file_path, column='Diffusion Coefficient', save=False, png=False)

   Plots the GITT results curve

   It gives a plot of the selected parameter over SOC

   :param df_input: DataFrame containing the data to plot
   :type df_input: pandas.DataFrame
   :param file_path: Path to the file to process
   :type file_path: str
   :param column: Column to plot (default is 'Diffusion Coefficient').
   :type column: str, optional
   :param save: Whether to save the plots as .html files(default is False).
   :type save: bool, optional
   :param png: Whether to display the plots as .png files (default is False).
   :type png: bool, optional

   :returns: Plot as a Plotly figure
   :rtype: go.Figure


.. py:function:: plot_HPPC_result(df, file_path, column='R', save=False, png=False)

   Plots the HPPC results curve

   It gives a plot of the selected parameter over SOC for both charge and dicharge pulses

   :param df_input: DataFrame containing the data to plot
   :type df_input: pandas.DataFrame
   :param file_path: Path to the file to process
   :type file_path: str
   :param save: Whether to save the plots as .html files(default is False).
   :type save: bool, optional
   :param png: Whether to display the plots as .png files (default is False).
   :type png: bool, optional

   :returns: Plot as a Plotly figure
   :rtype: go.Figure
